CHOICE: NONE

CONFIDENCE: 4

None of the three proposed answers matches the bound I recall. For projective surfaces not of maximal Albanese dimension, Debarre's inequality gives $p_g \ge 2q-4$. I believe the open-surface analogue is $\overline{P}_1(V) \ge 2\overline{q}(V)-4$, which is sharp, but I have not verified that source here. Solutions 1 (2q−3), 2 (2q−2), and 3 (q−1) all give different linear polynomials, so none is correct.
